dedupe_keys.name: prediction of short term traffic speeds using deep learning models

description: The source compares deep-learning prediction of average traffic speed using five Bluetooth sensors in Vigo, Spain. Inputs are fifteen-minute observations collected since 2014 and the prediction horizon is the next fifteen minutes. LSTM performs best in the reported comparison. Weather and other factors are suggestions for future improvement, not established model inputs. No new raw sensor dataset or executable release is inferred. The source authors provide the native description and file descriptors through Zenodo. Only metadata was inspected; no measurements, archives, source code or document bodies were retrieved. Public access and the deposit document licence do not establish executable access, software reuse rights or operating costs. Coverage remains bounded to the named experiments, with other geographic and temporal fields unknown. Related project resources may overlap; common project membership does not establish identical simulation inputs or results.
name: Prediction of Short Term Traffic Speeds Using Deep Learning Models
